The '''Shistavanen''', colloquially nicknamed '''wolfmen''' for their [[Wolf/Legends|lupine]] and [[Wolf/Legends|wolf]]-like appearance, were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uvena Prime/Legends|Uvena Prime]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Shistavanen_Wolfman-BotF_by_Joel_Hustak.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A Shistavanen in action]]
The Shistavanen [[Homeworld/Legends|originated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uvena Prime/Legends|Uvena Prime]] in the [[Uvena system/Legends|Uvena system]]. In addition to natural evolution, the Shistavanen species was shaped by unknown genetic engineers. Like many lupine species, Shistavanen had pronounced muzzles, sharp claws, long pointed teeth, and pointed ears set on top of their heads.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Shistavanen also possessed large glowing [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and could also run at high speeds for hours without getting tired, alternately using two or four limbs. As predators, they possessed keen senses of hearing and smell, and excellent night vision. However this also made them sensitive to light, sound and smell of the damaging type. Some, such as [[Caet Shrovl]], could be [[Albino/Legends|albino]] (although she believed her condition to be the result of an experiment the Empire did on her mother, rather than natural causes).

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Good, I'm ready for food, fresh food&hellip; wet food.|[[Hovrak]]|<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref>}}
As a species, the Shistavanen were [[Speciesism|isolationists]]. This was evident by the species colonizing all the unpopulated worlds in the Uvena system to prevent them from being settled by non-Shistavanen, their restrictive trade laws (which were unapologetic in how they favored their own kind over off-world traders), and from the fact that they did not often mix with other species. Most of their society used technology similar to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], though some parts of Uvena Prime used slightly less sophisticated technology.<ref name="AE" />

A minority of Shistavanen were more outgoing, and traveled the galaxy's [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="AE" /> Even these Shistavanen usually remained by themselves or with other Shistavanen. Due to their natural predatory instincts, Shistavanen commonly found employment as [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Many other species reacted badly to Shistavanen, since their isolationist culture made them an unfamiliar sight, and their predatory appearance put other species on edge. Those who were [[Albino/Legends|albino]], like [[Caet Shrovl]], could face mistreatment for their difference.

Shistavanen names included Shaalir Rech and Sirul Rosk.

==History==
[[File:LakSivrak.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Lak Sivrak/Legends|Lak Sivrak]], a Shistavanen scout.]]
During [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reign, despite the [[New Order/Legends|New Order's]] xenophobia towards non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents regularly employed Shistavanen scouts to track down criminals, rebels and other persons of interest.

==Shistavanen in the galaxy==
During the Clone Wars, [[Voolvif Monn]], was a powerful [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. A [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Severian]] worked for the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], but perished during his hunt for [[Sagoro Autem]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Lak Sivrak/Legends|Lak Sivrak]], a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scout, joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]; [[Riv Shiel]] did the same, becoming a [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a Shistavanen named [[Hovrak]] became a [[Adjutant Advisor]] of the speciesist [[Diversity Alliance]]. [[Caet Shrovl]], an [[Albino/Legends|albino]] Shistavanen female, was a member of Rock Squadron of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] utilized by [[Leonia Tavira]] of the [[Invidious]].
